messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny runtime hotfix PR that fixes token truncation when batching. Need 2x LGTM before today's release cutoff (17:00 UTC). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5123
Maria: I can take it now, give me 15m
TJ: CI is failing on nvidia-114 tests, looks like a flaky perf test
Alex: thanks — I pushed a retry commit, should rerun
DeployBot: CI pipeline started for PR #5123 (build/infra, unit/tests)
Sophia: left one comment about a log message, non-blocking. overall looks small.
Samir: is runtime-owner approval required or any two folks? Our rule in the release doc says one runtime-owner + one other for runtime hotfixes
Alex: yes, we need a runtime-owner. @Samir can you sign off after the CI green?
Maria: quick pass done, LGTM from me pending green CI :thumbsup:
TJ: CI flakes fixed, all green now. re-running the failing job passed.
Samir: reviewed the change, it's narrowly scoped. I checked the KV cache handling — LGTM
Alex: fantastic — merging now to the release branch and cherry-picking to stable
Alex: command I used:
```
git checkout release/v1.14
git merge --no-ff 5123
git push origin release/v1.14
```
DeployBot: Merge completed for PR #5123, created release candidate tag rc-2026-03-17-5
Maria: can we also backport to 1.13? small but customer-facing
Samir: created backport PR 5130, tagging @TJ for a quick look
TJ: taking a look at backport now
TJ: LGTM on backport as well, merging :shipit:
Alex: release cutoff satisfied — thanks everyone, rolling out the RC to staging
DeployBot: Scheduled rollout: rc-2026-03-17-5 -> staging at 2026-03-17T18:05:00Z
Sophia: will monitor logs during staging smoke tests
Maria: thanks all :heart:
